 Hon'Ble Avnish Saxena, J.
1 .  Sri Brijesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for accused-applicant appears and submits that the accused applicant is friend of main accused, who passed away.
After he has been enlarged on bail, he left for earning livelihood and could not appear before the trial court.
He further submits that there is no allegation of rape against the applicant but the cognizance has been taken against the accused even under Section 376 IPC.
The accused is apprehending arrest as NBW has been issued.
The matter pertains to jumping of bail.
Hence, seeks interference of this Court.

2. Learned AGA is present for the State-opposite party no.1.
3.
There is no point in issuance of notice to opposite party no.2 as the matter pertains to issuance of NBW and process 82 Cr.P.C..

4. At this juncture, learned counsel prayed that the interest of the applicant may be protected till he flies the NBW recall application or bail application, as the case may be, before the court concerned.
5. Considering that the accused-applicant is accomplices the main accused, who has already passed away, the accused-applicant has jumped the bail.
The accused-applicant may not be arrested for 30 days from today during which period the applicant may move appropriate application before the trial court.
6. Request is made to the trial court to consider that the applicant was continuously appearing in the trial represented by a counsel.
Further to consider the reason for his absence on the date fixed during his release on bail and pass an order sympathetically, but successive jumping of bail is not to be ignored.
7. The application is, accordingly disposed of.

(Avnish Saxena,J.) November 6, 2025 Abhishek Sri.
